acceptance_rule: Gate 4 must improve aggregate EV/PnL versus current baseline, improve at least two windows without unacceptable drawdown/concentration drift, and beat accepted compression/distribution default-off comparators; if not, no shared helper is promoted.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC 6-K foreign issuer text with explicit positive operating updates or raised outlook, plus same-day liquid SPY-relative absorption, may identify ADR information shocks missed by domestic SEC event sleeves.

nearest.reopen_condition: Forward replacement-value rows or a materially richer post-earnings event-quality field; do not simply retune the pre-event RS threshold.

A retry needs a materially new PIT state field, such as real-time breadth/changepoint persistence or cost-adjusted replacement rows; do not simply retune pressure thresholds, hold days, cooldown, or paper notional on this frozen sample.

A retry needs materially richer free PIT event evidence, such as parsed agreement/product/customer/buyback/guidance semantics from the filing text, event-time before/after close verification, or a shared daily snapshot field that separates economically material 8-K business updates from generic Item 8.01/7.01 filings. Pure subtype or momentum threshold tuning stays frozen.

A retry needs materially new PIT evidence outside this text field, such as a broader free data edge in customer/supplier relations, source-utility labels, or forward daily parity observations showing this semantic bucket displaces accepted distribution or allocator candidates.

prediction.confidence_reason: exp-20260622-014 repaired production-visible 6-K event/text rows across all windows, and 6-K is a new foreign-issuer channel; however SEC text candidate pools are saturated and semantic false positives plus accepted-comparator weakness are likely.
